question: What is the meaning of or disposal at end-of-life in relation to treatment facilities information?
description: The meaning of "disposal at end-of-life" in relation to treatment facilities information refers to the documentation and processes involved in sorting, collecting, and treating objects during their end-of-life phase. This includes the environmental and social impact assessment of the product throughout its life cycle, as well as the origin of the materials used. The treatment facilities information would detail the specific facilities and methods used to recycle or dispose of materials at the end of their useful life, ensuring compliance with regulations such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR). This information is crucial for optimizing the design, production, usage, and disposal of products to support circular economy objectives and ensure supply chain transparency.
